Chapter 6821: Glory Of Past

Chapter 6821: Glory Of Past

Unfortunately, the light-infused cultivators couldn’t stop an overlord’s descending power.

They became paralyzed on the ground, unable to move. When they looked up into the sky, they saw an eagle spreading its wings.

Frenzy City looked like a dot next to its claw. It just needed to spin its wings to swipe the stars.

His primordial dao laws were infected, unstable, and on the verge of erupting. This only made him more dangerous and dreadful.

“Primal Eagle.” The defenders became alarmed.

“Golden Lamp, still as stubborn and annoying as ever.” He uttered cold, soul-piercing words.

“Golden Lamp didn’t yield in the past and will not yield now or in the future.” While everyone was afraid, Thunder Emperor didn’t yield before the overlord’s might.

“Then another massacre is due.” His eyes gleamed murderously, capable of mincing cultivators.

“Sure, but Golden Lamp will still be there without us.” Six-foot laughed.

“Lives will find a way until the darkness is gone.” Thunder said confidently, boosting morale among her allies.

“Very well, then your generation shall be wiped out today.” The eagle despised the stubborn nature of these defenders. This was instinctive and etched in the bones.

Although he didn’t descend, he could still kill all of them.

“Big bird, you have fallen. The glory of the past is all gone.” Another profound voice sounded, accompanied by crimson tides.

They gathered together to form a great crimson tree. When it spread its branches and leaves, it could cover all of Golden Lamp.

The other iron trees didn’t have leaves but this one had silver and golden leaves everywhere.

“Goldsilver Tree.” The overlord of Golden Lamp had shown up.

“Still alive, I see.” The eagle became serious.

“I can’t die while you yet live. I have to take you with me first, one of the rare traitors in our history. I must rid Golden Lamp of its disgraceful smirch.” The tree said.

“Enough of your righteous act.” The eagle shouted.

He didn’t care for others, but this tree was older than he was. They once fought together but now, he had fallen.

“It is my mission. A traitor such as yourself will always be a looming threat.” The tree said.

“Haha, you dare to leave Golden Lamp to pursue me?” The eagle uttered coldly.

Of course the inhabitants didn’t dare to enter Stygian. Existences of the darkness would feast on them immediately.

“But aren’t you here today?” The tree said.

“That is not happening. Alas, I am feeling merciful and out of respect for the seniors back then, I won’t kill you all. However, you must hand the shrine over to me.” The eagle said.

“We do not negotiate with the darkness.” The tree refused.

“Don’t be so sure, I do not want it for myself but rather, this is a command from Devouring Abyss. They won’t be as kind as I, and you all will be helpless then.” The eagle said.
